(3) BREAKEVEN - once the trade has gone +0.75R in favour, the stop moves to entry + round-trip fees + stop slippage (true scratch); the move is journaled. Base geometry: Top-5 most volatile (mean 1h range, last 24h) of the 15 most liquid HL perps (24h notional), re-ranked hourly, BTC excluded. FIB pullback at a flipped level (5m legs, 7d, 0.15% tol, stop beyond the level/0.886), limit entry. Slippage = 2bp + half the live spread. Entries that trigger in the same 1-minute cycle are ranked by net R across all coins and the best fills first; if a cap/position limit then binds the others are logged 'outranked'.
